search.placeholder: Name, artist, venue, keyword — accents optional...

route.title: My route
route.intro: Add events from Explore, reorder the stops and open directions.
route.shareTitle: Share the route with apps on this device
route.shareUnsupported: This browser cannot use system sharing.
route.emptyHint: Add events from Explore or pick a suggested itinerary.
route.toastExists: This event is already in the route.

prompts.intro: Type your own question, or pick a suggested prompt to open in ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. The website context is always kept and updated with the current time, date and location; only the question below is editable. Edits are saved on this device.
prompts.hint: Type your own question. The website context above is fixed.
prompts.placeholder: e.g. What is there for kids around Hoan Kiem Lake tonight?
prompts.actionsAria: Open your prompt in an AI service
prompts.copied: Prompt copied. Paste it into the app's chat box.
prompts.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically; select the text and copy it manually.
prompts.blockedTab: The browser blocked the new tab.
prompts.opened: Opened {provider} with the prompt filled in.

map.canvasAria: Interactive map of festival events in Hanoi
map.fallbackTitle: The interactive map could not load
map.fallbackBody: The browser is blocking WebGL or the CDN. The event list, filters and route planner still work.
map.fallbackLog: The map could not start; switching to the list view.

live.label: Live
live.titleUnavailable: No festival events today, so Live is off.
live.titleOffDate: Off: showing every event on the selected day. Tap to return to Live today.
live.titleOffAll: Off: showing the whole programme. Tap to return to Live today.
live.titleOn: On: showing events that are open today, refreshed in Hanoi time. Tap to see the full schedule.
live.noteOn: Showing events that are still open today.
live.noteDate: Showing every event on the selected day.
live.noteNoEvents: No events today; showing the whole programme.

nearby.label: Nearby
nearby.titleUnavailable: Add stops to the route to use Nearby.
nearby.titleEntry: Open the route and see the programme around its stops.
nearby.titleOn: On: showing every event around the route. Tap to show only the stops.
nearby.titleOff: Off: showing only the route stops. Tap to bring in nearby events.

participated.label: Attended
participated.titleUnavailable: Mark an event as attended in its detail card to use this view.
participated.titleOn: On: attended events are shown normally. Tap to dim them.
participated.titleOff: Off: attended events are dimmed. Tap to show them normally.
participated.savedToast: Saved this event to your attended list.

detail.note: Information comes from the festival calendar published at lehoithietkesangtao.vn (updated 18/11/2026). Please check with the organiser before attending.

location.title: Share your location?
location.body: Let the page use your current location to show you on the map and measure distances to events. Your location is processed in the browser only and is never stored.
location.pick: Pick a point on the map
location.unsupported: This browser does not support GPS location.
location.insecure: Location sharing only works over HTTPS or on localhost.
location.approximate: No precise GPS yet, trying an approximate location…
location.failed: Could not get your current location.
location.denied: Location access is not allowed. Enable location for this site in your browser settings.
location.unavailable: Could not determine your current location.
location.timeout: The location request timed out. Try again.
location.shownToast: Your location is now on the map.
location.tapMapToast: Tap the map to choose a starting point.
location.pickedToast: Starting point selected on the map.
